name: ux-auditor
description: UX and usability audit for codebases and web applications. Based on the 21 Laws of UX (lawsofux.com) and NN/g 10 Usability Heuristics. Evaluates Desktop and Mobile viewports, simulates age cohort friction (Gen Z, Adults, Seniors), checks touch targets (Fitts's Law), color contrast, form friction, and produces scored reports (Markdown + interactive HTML) with concrete code remedies and phased action plans.
